notes.title: Updates for January 1, 2025
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Steam client is now fully updated to match the main client! This update includes numerous enhancements and changes, such as:

[list]
[*] Bug Fixes: Improved stability and performance.
[*] New Events: Experience the excitement of Port City!
[*] Revamped Siege War: A fan-favorite event returns with new improvements.
[/list]

Don’t miss out—join the action and play today!

notes.title: Khan Rebirth
notes.content:
What is new?

[h1]XTREME SERVER[/h1]
This server is a for fun server that is targetted to those who basically no longer have a lot of time to play. 

Features:
[list]
[*] High experience rate
[*] High KI rate
[*] Slates and Chestnuts have high fame rate
[*] A lot of premium items
[*] Cut skill is allowed and is unlimited
[*] High level Character Kits
[*] Max level 999
[*] Rebirth activated
[*] and many more...
[/list]

[h1]MOUNTS[/h1]
Tamed Boar
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/26p2nT3V/Basic-Boar.jpg[/img]
Battle Boar

Battle Horse

[h1]DRAGON PETS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Green Dragonic Essence       -    Defense (Level 1-99)         Drops in Mar and Boracay Map
[*] Black Dragonic Essence        -    Attack (Level 1-99)           Drops in Mar and Boracay Map 
[*] Gold Dragonic Essence         -    Storage (Level 100-Up)     Drops in Sib2, Sib3 and Shang-tu Map
[*] Orange Dragonic Essence     -    Defense (Level 100-Up)    Drops in Sib2, Sib3 and Shang-tu Map
[*] Red Dragonic Essence          -    Attack (Level 100-Up)       Drops in Sib2, Sib3 and Shang-tu Map
[*] White Elder Dragonic Relic   -     Storage (Level 100-Up)   For rebirth only
[/list]

[h1]REBIRTH SYSTEM[/h1]
A new NPC (Pixie) will be added to Wrocklaw Map for the Rebirth System.

Requirements for Rebirth:
[list]
[*] Level 430.
[*] No equipped armors, weapon and accessories.
[/list]
 
Fee for Rebirth: (first rebirth)
[list]
[*] 10,000 fame.
[*] 10,000 Shang-tu Arena score points. (points will be subtracted)
[/list]
 
What will happen? Character will...
[list]
[*] Go back to level 10 (First rebirth).
[*] Get 0.5% of HP and MP.
[*] Sample: 5,000 for 1,000,000
[*] Get 10% of all stats.
[*] Sample: 1,000 for 9,999
[*] Be cleared of all learned skills.
[*] Obtain a White Elder Dragonic Pendant.
[/list]
 
For every rebirth; the fee and the results will change.
[list]
[*] Fee increase +1,000 fame and points per rebirth. (max: 50,000)
[*] Sample: 15,000 on 5th rebirth.
[*] Level will be subtracted by -1 per rebirth but will stop subtracting at level 1. (min: 1)
[*] Sample: Lv 3 on 7th rebirth.
[*] Stats retained increases by +2% per rebirth but will stop at +30%. (max: 30%)
[*] Sample: 26% on 8th rebirth.
[*] Bonus HP and MP per rebirth increases by 300 but will stop at a total of +4,000. (max: 4,000)
[*] Sample: Total of +1,716,000 bonus HP and MP at level 430 on 13th rebirth.
[/list]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Tw0qkMhV/Rebirth-System.png[/img]

notes.title: Full Disclosure of MIP party incident
notes.content:
Good day Khanatics,

As a background of the incident, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/451130/discussions/0/371918937278126970/]see this discussion[/url].

[code]On the 5th of April a GM (Game Moderator) was seen in Mist Iron Prison, allegedly in a group (party) with 5 other non-GM players.
[/code]

Alleged Party Members
[list]
[*] [GM]-TamahaganE (knight)
[*] THAILAND (knight)
[*] me0zzzzz (sorcerer)
[*] IS7 (knight)
[*] Sylar (assassin)
[*] Olive (micko)
[/list]

[quote=GM-TamahaganE] I was just checking the Ki rates as players were reporting it was too low. [/quote]

[h1]What was wrong with the way it was tested?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rates was not properly tested because of the level gap created between the non-GM characters vs the GM character.
[*] GM's should never party with non-GM characters unless it is necessary, such as when there is an event.
[*] When testing, GM's should never use GM characters because it is unbalanced and could give unreliable results. (should only test with configured normal characters that will be deleted afterwards)
[/list]

[i]Everything that follows is based on the investigation of the game logs.[/i]
[list]
[*] The party lasted for [b]112 seconds[/b] (about 2 minutes)
[*] About 20 monsters were killed 
[*] [b]1 Lynch King[/b] was killed
[*] Only [b]Ki Balls and Golds[/b] were looted for the duration of the party
[*] ...checking/additional_info
[/list]

[h1]...INVESTIGATION ON-GOING (will be updated)[/h1]

[h1]Resolution[/h1]
A resolution is currently being internally debated, one of the leaned on option is to [i]remove all ki, exp, items acquired within the party[/i]. 

[h1]Apologies[/h1]
We are very sorry for our reckless judgement. We apologize to the whole Khan Steam community and to those who got involved, for it was not their fault.

P.S. GM-TamahaganE has voluntarily resigned on the day of the incident.

Today, we have updated the client to include a Game Guard which auto bans anyone who uses cheats, this includes speed hack and cut. All auto bans have a length of 1 day for the 1st and 2nd offense. On the 3rd offense the cheater will be banned permanently.

Windows 8 and 10 will also get an update today with a temporary solution. Just choose the Play windows 8 or 10 option when pressing the Play button on the steam client. Just follow the instructions given.

Bakbakhan na ulit!
Blaze GM Team

notes.title: Urgent DDOS Warning (Mar 23)
notes.content:
We are currently under attack of DDOS, we've put the networks on lockdown. 

We will update this annoucement once the problem has been sorted out.     

[h1]UPDATE 1[/h1]
We are currently moving to a DDOS protected servers. Migration could take a few hours. 

[h1]UPDATE 2[/h1]
Migration has just begun.

[h1]UPDATE 3[/h1]
Database migration will start in a few minutes.

[h1]UPDATE 4[/h1]
Data has been migrated, we will now put the servers back online. We'll finish the final part of the migration some other day. (Last part: Network Config)

notes.title: Updated Windows 8 and 10 Support
notes.content:
A few hours before release we have updated the client to support windows 8 and 10 out of the box, meaning you won't have to configure anything.

One of the noticeable changes is the [b]Run As Admin[/b] requirement on Windows 8 and 10. There was a permission issue which was causing the client to fail. Adding this option fixes that issue.

But because we can't target which platform [i]Operating System[/i] it should ask to [b]Run As Admin[/b]. Now also Windows XP, Vista and 7 also asks to [b]Run As Admin[/b]. Do not panic, this is completely safe and won't affect your system nor your gameplay.

Update Summary:
[list]
[*] Khan Client now works in Windows 8 and 10.
[*] Slow loading bug has been fixed.
[*] Small screen bug has been fixed.
[*] Steam overlay now works as expected.
[*] Khan Client now asks to [b]Run As Admin[/b].
[/list]

12 more hours to go till #bakbakhan !!

notes.title: Experimental Windows 8 & 10 Support
notes.content:
We have added an experimental support for windows 8 and 10. But the player must change a few settings themselves.

The KhanClient.exe has to be set to run on Windows 7 Compatibility mode and must be "run as admin" in order to work. (see screenshot below)

Known Issues:
[list]
[*] Slow Loading.
[*] Steam Overlay doesn't work.
[/list]

This will be updated as soon as we find a better way of dealing with the issue. As of now the options mentioned above it the only way to play on Win 8 and later.

[img]https://scontent.fmnl2-1.fna.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtl1/v/t1.0-9/936562_196735110695796_5415848326832833629_n.png?oh=d6e0c42b8e37c55b9c3e835121d23b31&oe=5787B501[/img]
